claim: The command-line tool creates signed JSON and HTML file lists with paths, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes, reports exact differences, and handles empty folders.
sandbox: fresh temporary sender and recipient folders; valid, tampered, empty, missing, changed, and extra-file cases

claim: In a 10,000-file fixture, changing one file reports only that path.
sandbox: new 10,000-file temporary folder; assert checked count, exact changed path, and zero false reports

claim: The browser verifier does not upload or store selected files and the product has no account, analytics, advertising, or tracking.
sandbox: fresh browser context; real CLI-signed file; intercept all verification requests and inspect localStorage and IndexedDB

claim: The web and command-line demos use bundled text sample files in isolation and report one missing, one changed, and one extra path.
sandbox: inspect honest Markdown/text fixtures; use a fresh temporary CLI directory and browser context seeded with a real-data marker; run, reset, and leave demo

claim: The web demo reopens and completes its local check offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; first online load, service-worker control, offline reload, completed sample check

claim: The command-line tool encrypts JSON and HTML outputs without exposing filenames and does not change source files.
sandbox: fresh source folder and passphrase; inspect both age files, verify encrypted JSON, compare source bytes

claim: The command-line tool emits parseable JSON output for scripts.
sandbox: fresh temporary folder; parse keygen and create stdout and assert documented fields

claim: The package command copies files and signed outputs into a separately verifiable directory without changing source files.
sandbox: fresh source, signed list, and package; compare bytes and verify package/files as a separate destination

claim: Verification results use exit 0 for clean, 3 for differences, 4 for trust failures, 1 for operational failures, and 2 for invalid usage.
sandbox: fresh signed fixture; invoke one observable case for each documented exit status

claim: Format version 1 uses ordered slash-separated relative paths, path/size/SHA-256 fields, compact payload signatures, and rejects unsafe paths.
sandbox: fresh nested fixture, payload mutation, and traversal rejection unit case

claim: The product is free under the MIT License and has no account gate.
sandbox: inspect repository license and fresh landing-page context for source link and absence of sign-in controls
